job.job_description:
Backend Developer / Tester




Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 0 - 2 Years

Department: Technology

Company: ElevateCareer.AI




About ElevateCareer.AI




ElevateCareer.AI is an AI-powered career readiness and hiring intelligence platform bridging the gap between education and employment. We help students, institutions, and organizations assess, develop, and hire talent through AI-driven assessments, mock interviews, communication practice, coding assessments, and competency-based evaluation.

As part of our growing technology team, you'll work closely with product, AI, and operations teams to build and improve a platform that makes hiring and career development more skill-focused, measurable, and accessible.




About the Role




We're looking for a Backend Developer / Tester (02 years' experience) with a strong foundation in Python and hands-on exposure to Django. This role suits a fresher or early-career developer who has gained practical experience through an internship, previous job, or a substantial academic/personal project.




Key Responsibilities



Develop, maintain, and test backend applications using Python and Django
Work on APIs, backend logic, database interactions, and application workflows
Write clean, reusable, maintainable Python code
Debug backend issues and identify root causes of application errors
Perform functional and API-level testing of backend features
Identify, document, and track bugs, working with the dev team to resolve them
Collaborate with developers and product teams to translate requirements into backend features
Perform basic database operations and understand data flow across the backend
Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and deployment
Work with basic DevOps practices Git, deployment workflows, environments, application logs
Help ensure the platform's stability, reliability, and performance



Must-Have Skills




Python Hands-on experience via internship, job, or a meaningful project. Solid grasp of Python fundamentals (functions, classes, data structures, exception handling) and ability to debug/troubleshoot.




Django Project-level experience is mandatory: at least one project built with Django, with basic understanding of its architecture (models, views, URLs, templates, ORM). Familiarity with building or consuming APIs is a plus.




Basic DevOps Knowledge — Comfortable with Git/GitHub; working understanding of deployment, environment variables, logs, or CI/CD. Docker knowledge is a bonus.




Testing & Debugging — Understanding of software testing fundamentals; ability to test backend functionality and APIs; strong debugging and problem-solving skills; can identify, reproduce, and document bugs clearly.




Good to Have



Django REST Framework (DRF)
REST APIs and HTTP methods
PostgreSQL or MySQL
Docker
Linux/command-line environments
Postman or similar API testing tools
Basic frontend knowledge (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)



Education




B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / M.Tech or a related technical degree. Candidates with strong practical projects and relevant skills are encouraged to apply even without formal work experience.




What We Look For



Strong logical and problem-solving ability
Willingness to learn new technologies
Ability to translate technical requirements into working solutions
Attention to detail while testing and debugging
Good communication and collaboration skills
Ownership and accountability toward assigned tasks
Genuine interest in backend development and software quality



Why Join ElevateCareer.AI?



Work on a real-world AI-powered EdTech and HRTech platform
Gain hands-on experience in backend development, testing, APIs, and DevOps
Work closely with product, AI, and technology teams
Contribute to features used in real-world assessments, hiring, and career development
Learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment



If you're a Python developer who has built Django projects and wants to grow in backend development while gaining exposure to testing and DevOps, we'd love to hear from you.
